item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei left citizens broadly safer from political violence, intergroup violence, displacement, or preventable domestic insecurity.\nThe positive items are narrow and procedural: a temporary no-retaliation posture after Isfahan, nuclear watchdog access, and selective pardons.\nI did not find evidence of a durable reduction in the underlying violence climate; the year’s dominant pattern remained repression, executions, and coercive social control.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty said Iranian forces still had not been independently investigated for killings, torture, sexual violence, and disappearances, and that hundreds of protesters and bystanders had been killed in the crackdown. This is strong evidence that the domestic safety environment remained violent and unaccountable.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.9"]},{"title":"Iran chokehold on dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent","summary":"HRW reported hundreds of protester deaths, mass arrests, torture, and no transparent investigations into security-force abuse. This directly undercuts any claim that citizens ended 2024 safer from political violence than they began it.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8"]},{"title":"Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed war on drugs","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/","summary":"Amnesty documented a major execution surge, including unfair Revolutionary Court proceedings and mass use of the death penalty. That is evidence of rising preventable insecurity and state violence, not improvement.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.1","3B.2","3B.6"]},{"title":"Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/","summary":"The new law added prison, flogging, fines, travel bans, and even death-penalty exposure for veiling-related dissent, while expanding police and security powers. This is a clear marker of worsening state-backed insecurity for women and girls.","question_ids":["3B.10","3B.5","3B.7","3B.8"]},{"title":"Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-19","url":"https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/","summary":"Reuters said Tehran’s no-retaliation posture after the Isfahan incident appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest restraint signal I found, but it was tactical and short-lived rather than a durable safety gain.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.10","3B.9"]},{"title":"Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/","summary":"Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is a narrow late-year restraint signal, but it concerns nuclear verification, not broad domestic safety for citizens.","question_ids":["3B.10","2B.10","3B.4"]},{"title":"Leader approves pardoning, commuting sentences of about 3,000 Iranian convicts","publisher":"Press TV","date":"2024-09-20","url":"https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts","summary":"Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,887 convicts, including some security-related cases and minors.
